title: Am I affected by CVE-2024-21762 with FortiOS 7.2.5?
prompt: Am I affected by CVE-2024-21762? My firewall runs FortiOS 7.2.5 and is reachable from the internet. Answer in a short paragraph: the verdict, the version to upgrade to, and the evidence.

reference.answer.md: Yes. FortiOS 7.2.5 is affected by CVE-2024-21762. It is in the CISA KEV list, so upgrade to 7.2.7 or later. CVE.org lists 7.2.0 to 7.2.6 as affected and NVD says the same.
